description: Source code for MAX31855 temperature sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, data fetching, and temperature conversion functions.

methods.name: max31855_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches sample data from the MAX31855 sensor via SPI.

methods.name: max31855_channel_get
methods.description: Converts raw sample data into temperature readings for specified sensor channels.

methods.name: max31855_init
methods.description: Initializes the MAX31855 device, checking SPI bus readiness.
